brief_summary: To Evaluate and Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Ezetimibe Plus Atorvastatin Versus Atorvastatin in Hypercholesterolemic Patients at High Risk for Coronary Heart Disease Not Adequately Controlled on Atorvastatin 40 mg.
brief_title: To Evaluate Ezetimibe Plus Atorvastatin Versus Atorvastatin in Patients With High Cholesterol Not Controlled on Atorvastatin 40 mg (0653-090)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with LDL-C \>70 mg/dL \& on a stable dose of atorvastatin 40 mg

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating women or intending to become pregnant
* Patient with sensitivity or intolerance to ezetimibe or atorvastatin

official_title: A Multicenter, Rand., Double-Blind, Titration Study to Evaluate & Compare the Efficacy & Safety of Ezetimibe Plus Atorvastatin Vs Atorvastatin in Hypercholesterolemic Pts. at High Risk for CHD Not Adequately Controlled on Atorvastatin 40 Mg

primary_outcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 6 in Low-Density Lipoprotein (LDL)-C
